high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from "The Indian Express," a news website. The article discusses the External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar's briefing to Opposition parties on India's Afghanistan policy following the Taliban takeover. The main focus of the briefing was on India's evacuation efforts, but it also mentioned that the Indian government's policy is to wait and watch. The text highlights that the Modi administration has prioritized safe passage for Indian citizens and minorities of Indian origin over Afghan nationals.
